faceA:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square diffuse UV texture map for one adult male head on an original PS1 / early-PS2 low-poly game character, intended to be mechanically downsampled to 256 x 256.
Input images: both supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: emulate their convincingly adult, grounded polygonal character aesthetic and coarse hand-painted diffuse shading. Do not copy their clothing, facial expression, screenshot UI, scene, or exact person.
Primary request: Paint an opaque, edge-to-edge HEAD UV TEXTURE MAP, NOT a portrait illustration, of a warm tan adult man with short dark brown hair. His eyes are fully CLOSED, peacefully resting in a spa. Neutral relaxed straight eyebrows, softly closed relaxed mouth with level corners; no smile and no frown. Healthy broad adult face, subtle cheekbone and jaw planes, clean shaven or extremely subtle jaw shadow, natural adult nose. Make the expression reassuring and entirely calm.
Exact composition: The whole head is unwrapped horizontally as a cylindrical head map with its front at horizontal U=0.5 and its back seam at the left and right image edges U=0 and U=1. The FRONT FACE occupies ONLY the central half of the image, U=0.25 through U=0.75. The outer quarter on each side contains wraparound temples, small ear texture and rear hair/skin, NOT background. The two closed eyelid centers sit at U=0.40 and U=0.60. Both eyes symmetrically CLOSED with thin, softly painted brown lid creases, NO visible eyeballs.
Vertical UV placement, measured from the TOP edge: crown/dark hair band from y=0 to y=0.16; natural hairline at y=0.16; eyebrow centers at y=0.33; closed eyelid centers y=0.39; nose tip y=0.55; mouth center y=0.70; chin y=0.88. Head fills the square all the way to its outer boundaries. No visible neck, shoulders, shirt, empty margin, background or head silhouette cutout.
Style/medium: early PS2 diffuse texture artist painting, broad warm midtone color patches and restrained angular shadow shapes, slightly coarse low resolution painted detail. Modest soft baked illumination; no dramatic shadows, no glossy photoreal skin or pores. Use warm beige/tan midtones, muted rosy-brown mouth, dark brown hair; overall lighter neutral diffuse values suitable for dim spa lighting.
Constraints: ONE flat texture map only, one face only. No rendered 3D head, no lighting vignette, no text, no guides, no grid, no black outline, no black eye sockets, no eerie grin, no raised or knitted eyebrows, no exaggerated eyelids, no theatrical makeup.

body:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: shared square diffuse BODY UV TEXTURE ATLAS for adult male PS1 / early-PS2 low-poly spa NPCs, intended to be mechanically downsampled to 256 x 256.
Input images: both supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY for the adult proportions and broad angular hand-painted game texture shading. Do not copy clothes, facial expressions, screenshot interface or scenes.
Primary request: A production-ready opaque warm tan male skin UV atlas, edge-to-edge, with the exact rectangular layout below. It is a flat texture sheet, not an image of a person and not a rendered model. Healthy broad chest and softly strong build, subtle clavicles and natural pectoral planes. Soft understated abdomen, no shredded six-pack. Natural subdued painted anatomical shadows. Subtle damp sheen on upper shoulders only. No genitals, no head or face, no clothing.
Layout with pixel coordinates of the eventual 256 x 256 texture, origin TOP LEFT:
1. x=0..127, y=0..159 is FRONT TORSO rectangular UV island: shoulder/clavicle band across its top, broad chest with modest nipples below, abdomen and subtle navel toward its lower portion, waist at bottom. Front torso is fully stretched to fill this rectangle edge to edge.
2. x=128..255, y=0..159 is BACK TORSO rectangular UV island: upper shoulders across top, gentle shoulderblade planes, broad relaxed back, soft central spine valley, waist at bottom. Back torso is fully stretched to fill this rectangle edge to edge.
3. x=0..63, y=160..255 is ARM SKIN strip: warm skin with broad subtle longitudinal shading and one understated elbow suggestion. No fingers or arm silhouettes.
4. x=64..127, y=160..255 is LEG SKIN strip: warm skin with broad subtle longitudinal shading and one understated knee suggestion. No whole leg silhouette.
5. x=128..255, y=160..255 is generous clean hand/foot/neck skin patches, filled warm skin with soft variations only, usable for unwrapping simple low-poly hands, feet and neck. Do not draw literal isolated hands or feet.
All rectangular regions meet directly with no border, gutters, padding, black dividers, empty space or background. Keep all boundaries filled with harmonious warm tan skin; layout delineated ONLY by necessary anatomical painting.
Style/medium: original early-PS2 diffuse texture painting, broad subdued warm midtone blocks with modest muted brown baked shading, readable at 256px. Cohesive adult anatomy with reference-like angular painted forms. No excessive dark shadows, no black seams, no high-definition photographic skin, no pores, no heavy body hair, no extreme muscularity, no harsh specular highlights. ONE atlas only. No labels, no text, no numbers, no guides, no grid, no watermark.
towel:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square seamless diffuse UV texture for an ivory spa towel on a PS1 / early-PS2 low-poly game character, intended to be downsampled to 256 x 256.
Primary request: A flat, seamless, edge-to-edge ivory/offwhite spa terry cotton fabric texture, viewed straight on at uniform scale, with a quiet broad muted offwhite weave and barely visible small woven cotton-loop clusters. Natural soft cotton fabric, simple early-PS2 photographic fabric diffuse texture with restrained warm gray shading. The base should be warm ivory, with extremely low contrast fiber variation: most of the texture between soft offwhite and very light warm gray. No colored cast. Suggest a touch of soft terry weave, but keep it broadly smooth and calm so it stays attractive on low-poly towel geometry at 256 pixels.
Composition: fabric fills the entire square, no object silhouette, no background, no edges or hems. Seamless at all four edges, evenly lit diffuse material map with no directional lighting. One continuous flat fabric only.
Constraints: NO deep folds or large wrinkles because the model geometry handles folds. No hard black grain, no dot noise, no pixel-art static, no television static, no checkerboard, no high-frequency black-and-white speckles, no stripes, no borders, no text, no logos, no towel model or room scene. Do not make it gray/turquoise/blue. Do not exaggerate the loops. The finest loop pattern should be subtle and barely visible, with broad muted offwhite fiber groupings and low contrast warm gray accents.
